evals.prompt: The party destroyed the old stone bridge crossing the Ember River between Highreach and Stonehaven during their escape from Merchants Guild enforcers. This happened on 0496-03-20. Trade caravans can't cross anymore, Stonehaven is getting cut off from supplies, and the Merchants Guild is furious. Create a consequence file for this.
evals.expected_output: A properly formatted DM-only consequence file in Private/2. Reference/Events/Consequences/Active/ with full YAML frontmatter, Trigger section linking to relevant files, Impact bullets describing world changes, Current Status, and correct dataview query.

assertions.text: File is placed in Private/2. Reference/Events/Consequences/Active/
YAML frontmatter includes all required fields: fc-date, fc-category, type, name, status, severity, trigger, affected_entities, tags
type field is 'Consequence'
status field is 'Active'
severity field is 'Moderate' or 'Major'
fc-date is 0496-03-20
tags include Consequence, Crestfall
Trigger section contains wiki-link to triggering context
Impact section has 2-5 bullet points describing world changes (not event recap)
Current Status section present with 1-2 sentences
DM Notes section present and empty
Dataview query uses FROM [[]] (not FROM [[#this.file.name]])
No public file created — consequences are DM-only
File does NOT contain optional sections (Escalation Path, Resolution Options) unless user requested them
Brevity: entire file is scannable in under 10 seconds — fragments and bullets, not prose paragraphs

evals.prompt: The party ignored the Flushed Heirloom quest — they never went to recover the family heirloom from the sewers. The quest giver, an old woman in Highreach, is devastated and word has spread that the adventurers can't be trusted with personal favors. Create a consequence for this failed quest.
evals.expected_output: A consequence file linking to the existing Flushed Heirloom quest, with appropriate severity and status, describing reputation damage and NPC reaction.

assertions.text: File placed in correct Consequences directory
YAML frontmatter has all required fields
trigger field references the Flushed Heirloom quest
Trigger section contains wiki-link to the existing Flushed Heirloom quest file
Impact bullets focus on world changes (reputation, NPC attitudes) not event recap
affected_entities list includes relevant NPCs/locations
Searched vault for existing related consequence files before creating
Searched vault for the Flushed Heirloom quest file to link to
Dataview query uses FROM [[]] (not FROM [[#this.file.name]])
Brevity: scannable in 10 seconds

evals.prompt: Create a consequence for Randi killing the looters during the Highreach rebuilding.
evals.expected_output: Agent should find the existing 'Randi Kills Looters Consequence.md' file and present it to the user rather than creating a duplicate.

assertions.text: Agent searched the vault and found the existing 'Randi Kills Looters Consequence' file
Agent did NOT create a new duplicate consequence file
Agent presented the existing file content or referenced it
Agent offered to update/expand the existing file rather than creating new
